campaign: Transfer audio.cpp behavior into reusable Go audio operations and prove the CPU ingest-train-evaluate-serve lifecycle before broader architectures and CUDA
doctrine: Work and commit only in overgo_audiocpp; do not push or import master's plan. Honor explicit stops. Use operation-named common components and existing owners. Each downloaded reference is a pinned behavioral oracle, never a linked runtime or permanent product dependency. Granite Speech 5.0 470M TurboCTC is the first offline oracle, native Safetensors Nemotron 3.5 ASR the second and streaming oracle, and FireRedVAD the segmentation oracle; the incompatible Q8 GGUF remains rejected. Pin source revision, artifact, fixture and transform identities with independent boundary traces and explicit tolerances. Reuse audiodsp, safetensors, tokenizer, hostmath/tensor, modelrecipe, capabilityruntime, dataset, evaluation, runrecord, trainingprogram and trainingworkflow. Use concrete operation-named components, including those used by one recipe; model identity, tensor names, geometry, padding, normalization, ties and composition belong in declarations, never model-family execution branches. Add only a demonstrated missing operation with its real consumer in the same slice. Preserve one inference/training forward path and the existing loader, scheduler, optimizer, checkpoint and persistence owners. No general-purpose graph engine, parallel registry, dataset cache, service or verifier framework. Migrate callers and delete displaced paths together; measure API/state/buffer reduction alongside parity, not line count alone. First correct measurement semantics, then bounded dataset traversal and a real pinned CPU baseline, then frozen-base adaptation, exact stop and resume, evaluation, publication, reload and authenticated serving. The first adapter is identity-initialized on final hidden features before the frozen CTC projection; preserve tied weights and optimizer, random, scheduler and data-stream state. First lifecycle acceptance includes VAD composition, pre/post WER/resource evidence and complete OvergoDB lineage, but does not wait for encoder gradients, another ASR architecture, streaming ASR, voice or CUDA. Keep those capabilities as later work. Dataset preparation and VAD do not depend on a trained recognizer. Decode actual samples, account for every rejection, and quarantine policy-invalid, silent, near-silent, corrupt, clipped or non-finite inputs. Reference text never enters prediction. Use pinned LibriSpeech clean first; the historical silent AMI materialization remains quarantined until its exact source/transformation is established, and historical ingestion failures require replay against the original store and immutable identities, not isolated-store success alone. Reuse source-addressed Parquet/Arrow traversal and immutable outputs for scoring; do not eagerly copy a corpus or cache predictions for timing. Performance repetitions execute fresh inference, identify each attempt, and separate cold load, warm execution and publication spans. Unknown counters stay absent; boundary Go heap samples are not process peak memory, and unavailable peak/VRAM evidence cannot support a memory or promotion claim. Profiling is separate from timed runs. CPU remains the numerical authority; eligible CPU work proceeds while GPU capacity is occupied, and CUDA follows measured bottlenecks through kernels/manifest.json. Commit gates may use required GPU scope; unsupported or unavailable device execution never passes. Static DSP parity is not ASR parity, transport chunking is not native streaming, and segment offsets are not word timestamps. Every verify names one exact acceptance test with mandatory subchecks: add it to the existing owner as part of that step, run through cmd/plan -verify or the gate, require nonempty executed cases, and fail on missing artifacts or skipped subchecks. The acceptance names are planned work, not claims that the tests already exist. Report failures, denominators and no-gain outcomes; promotion requires the existing quality/resource policy. API consolidation follows existing owners: one bounded media.DecodeAudio path for encoded waveform ingestion, one shared PCM representation when synthesis is migrated, and distinct typed transcription/generated-audio artifacts. Keep ASR, synthesis, VAD, alignment and speaker operations separate; do not add an umbrella audio service or generic optional-field result. Reuse existing recipe selection, residency, cancellation, operation tracking and publication in serving. Preserve AudioStreamCursor progress/checkpoint ownership and AudioStreamSession concurrency/residency ownership. Consolidation migrates every actual caller and deletes displaced APIs in the same slice; prove unchanged accepted samples and explicit refusal semantics, not only fewer exported names. Grouped execution retains every open row identity and acceptance; group counts are derived from the live plan, not maintained as a historical total. No task is completed by reordering. Each lead implements every named member contract and binds component acceptances in verification_batch before final integration. Later members are exact verification receipts, not separate implementation campaigns. Read all member contracts before editing. Keep all original acceptance commands and capability obligations; only normal gated completion retires a row. Dependencies target the last required receipt of a prerequisite group. The current gate advances one row per commit; implementation grouping is not a claim of fewer commits or measured speedup. Reuse exact package/checkpoint evidence, not provisional commits, multi-row pruning, invented flush thresholds or another dispatcher. Synchronize master only before a group's lead when needed; pin its revision, review relevant owner changes, preserve the exact audio parent plan through first-parent-target merge completion, and replan afterward. Do not merge between a group's receipts or recursively after merge commits. A demonstrated urgent safety fix interrupts and revalidates affected evidence. Build on the committed CPU adapter publication and exact-resume owners. Complete VAD/segmentation and the CPU served lifecycle with cancellation/publication recovery next. Structural validation alone cannot prove dispatch readiness. Keep held-out baseline, CPU profiling and resource fitness together before encoder expansion or the second architecture. Group native recognizer/session/HTTP work and reuse that evidence for live operations/routing. Keep CPU artifact/oracle intake separate from required device execution; while GPU is occupied use the existing frontier and plan reorder to select eligible CPU work, never weaken acceptance. Generative-audio execution depends on its elected operations, not ASR CUDA completion. Master retains broad text benchmarking and platform cleanup. Record measured setup, executed/reused checks and total gate wall; no saving is claimed merely from grouping. After the CPU lifecycle and matched measurements, prioritize the second recognizer, native sessions and HTTP, and live service before full-encoder gradients. Synthesis consolidation also reuses the proven lifecycle before encoder expansion. CPU-only artifact admission has no dependency on unrelated ASR benchmark completion and remains an eligible alternative during resource contention. Preserve master's transaction-scoped store ownership, terminal package evidence and conservative subprocess-input selection; do not rebuild these in audio code. A live physical GPU reservation is unavailable capacity even at zero utilization: wait or select genuinely CPU-only work through the existing frontier, never bypass admission or repeatedly run the same blocked gate. Complete each implementation group's retained receipts before starting another eligible group; use the existing plan reorder when priority alone would interleave them. Current resource policy: inspect current availability rather than carrying historical occupancy forward. Shared gate admission is authoritative for an OS-held device reservation; free VRAM alone does not bypass that lock. Outside exclusive reservations, admit only work that fits actual resource budgets and isolate performance measurements. Distinguish CPU implementation and focused host verification from the commit gate's independently derived device requirements. Use the ready frontier to select dependency-ready CPU work when a device group is unavailable. Do not start device acceptances, GPU profiling or full gates known to require the occupied device. On resource-admission refusal, retain failed-attempt evidence and exact reusable checks, stop retrying the unchanged gate, and resume only after a confirmed handoff or successful normal admission. Never terminate another worktree's job, clear its reservation, mask devices, disable required checks or label missing execution successful. Complete related CPU implementation and verification together within the declared group; no provisional commits, cross-group source accumulation or manual completion. A pending merge does not prohibit independent CPU development. Preserve an exact recoverable merge candidate and keep subsequent source changes separately held; do not include them in the merge commit or mutate a candidate during its active gate. Resource contention blocks only operations requiring that resource, not implementation of the current audio group. Use existing gate preparation/checkpoint owners and validate the eventual commit scope; no bypass, false completion or duplicate scheduler.
